title: Starting a Discord soon. How do I navigate the “Is this AI” discussion?
author: Hfcsmakesmefart
selftext:
I’ve been working on my game for a year and a half. Started from a tutorial, coded by typing in everything myself. Artwise—images,Sprites, 3D characters are AI generated . Asset packs for environment.

It seems like a toxic environment out there. My instinct is to “deny” but sometimes my instincts betray me, and could backfire I guess.

comments.author: KnownPride
comments.body:
Outright ignore it. They're bunch of group that have never ending demand, while barely 1% of them will even play your game.

Btw toxic is part of the job, earning money digitally always filled with toxic community that you cannot avoid.  
Even before ai this group exist, they just use diff justification.

replies.author: Hfcsmakesmefart
replies.body:
Well I assume people are going to ask me, so my guess is that ignoring the question will just make them assume it’s AI. 

What I mean is I can’t really ignore the issue, maybe I can ignore or ban the haters.

comments.author: PositiveScarcity8909
comments.body:
Yeah, that's a stupid idea.

If your art is AI generated people are going to notice right away, denying it is ridiculous.

replies.author: PositiveScarcity8909
replies.body: It doesn't matter if this is AI or not because its not an actual game asset.

comments.author: purri-cat-studio
comments.body: If it looks good people won’t care, besides Reddit mods.

comments.author: SoCal_Hunter
comments.body:
lol.  The anxiety around here about the use of AI is hilarious.  

AI will be doing 99% of game development work from here on out.  It will become so normal so quick.  

Stop worrying.  Use it. Embrace it.  Let it do amazing things.  

Anyone who is on some holier than thou horse because they don’t like AI is about to get steamrolled by a tidal wave of change.

comments.author: marathonmeta
comments.body: Deny and lose any and all hope of people ever opening up their wallet to you. If you will lie about one thing, who is to say you won’t lie about everything?

comments.author: axius7
comments.body: ban words or sentences and have some bot moderate discussion. include a policy that states it is against rules for discussing controversial topics or topics with polarizing opinions. 1 unhappy user isn't worth causing an uproar that upsets actual players who are there for the game.

replies.author: ffxivthrowaway03
replies.body:
This is the way.  Make it clear that your discord is simply not the place for AI Wars Shitposting and ban people who are clearly there just to stir the pot.

Realistically it seems silly to start social media engagement unless your game is on the verge of release.  There's not a lot for a "community" about a game to do for a game that's not released other than act out.

comments.author: re-skob
comments.body: why would you deny? just be open about it, why would you want toxic people in your discord who hate the way you want to work? you'll never satisfy the anti-AI people, they'll always be trying to call you out or force you to do more to show your work and process to prove to them it's not AI, so just get rid of them and focus on your actual audience

replies.author: Hfcsmakesmefart
replies.body: I guess cause then I have to disclose it when it’s time to sell to, and I can’t “just ban” those people

comments.author: Disastrous_Sign_1204
comments.body:
Just don't ask on reddit 

I made a post here about a mod / game made with AI and was tied to the stake and light on fire 4 times 
Some one tried to stone me, but I ran fast 

Made the same post on fb on a user group 

Got questions asking about specs whole different world

AI is a tool, if you are not good at your craft you get slop 

If you are good you can get amazing things 
It closed the gap for a lot of people 

I don't know anything about code, but I know about gameplay 

The ideas that I had on my imagination came to life after a lot of iteration and test 

AI is not evil 
We are toxic xD 

If a coder embraces it he can multiply his reach by 4000 
Same for artists.

It's like outsourcing but cheaper

comments.author: StoneCypher
comments.body:
make a set of join rules that says "yes it's ai, don't ask and don't criticize," then mute the people who do it anyway and ban the people who repeat or get weird

there won't be many.  one or two a week if you're very popular

comments.author: DigitalDustChan
comments.body:
The same way that strippers navigate the "are those real?" subject.

(Do they do what you want them to do? Then they're more real than the ones that don't.)

comments.author: count023
comments.body: "yes it is. And if you don't like it feels free to pay me thousands I as a hobbiest need to hire humans to do the work instead. And if you don't like that here what a discord ban looks like"

replies.author: ConsistentAnalysis35
replies.body: I'm sure you're going to have great success managing your community. /s

replies.author: count023
replies.body: if the person is coming in to complain about your project having AI in it, they're not going to be swayed by nice words and will do nothing but antagonise everyone else. Dont waste time with troublemakers, ban them.

comments.author: ConsistentAnalysis35
comments.body:
Never lie. Being a liar is instant suicide if you want to be a successful game developer with a community around you.

If you can't help it, at least keep silent. But NEVER lie. There's psychos out there who keep their Sherlock hat handy at all times, and they *will* figure you out.

So be straight with the people.
